title: Choose HoloDeck's visual world
question: The roll assigned The Prompt Book. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll. Each sketch is the CopilotKit chat's first screen; the same world then dresses the test-view dashboard.

options.label: The Prompt Book
options.lineage: the stage manager's prompt book and script revision pages
options.thesis: Every run is a rehearsal: tool calls are numbered cues in the margin, prompt versions are coloured revision pages.
options.viewport: House-blue rail with agent and threads; a script-white conversation whose left margin numbers each tool call as a cue (Q1, Q2) bracketed to the answer lines it fed; memory timeline as a revision-coloured strip, 2020 blue and 2026 pink.
options.risk: If the cue margin is set timidly it reads as an ordinary chat with a left border; it has to carry real numbering and brackets.

raised.raise: Length is exact duration: every tool call and run carries a duration bar drawn on one shared time scale.
Nothing disappears, it cancels: superseded facts and replaced runs stay visible, struck through and stamped with the date they closed.
Data density without apology: tabular numerals and full-density tables wherever scores, costs and latencies appear.
Fixed furniture: a test case keeps the same name plate and one-line note in every run and every view.

options.label: The Compiled Register
options.lineage: point-in-time legislation registers and their compilation notes
options.thesis: Everything is shown as at a date: answers, scores and facts carry their compilation and section in the margin.
materials: section numbers in a hanging margin
options.viewport: A teal header with an 'As at' date control that every view obeys; the conversation set like a compiled section, tool evidence as numbered endnotes.
options.risk: The most familiar choice here and where most runs land; it also narrows a generic agent platform toward a legal-research look.

options.label: Lexicon, shoulder and plate
options.thesis: Black text to a fixed measure; colour lives only inside bordered plates, which here are the charts and tool results.
options.viewport: Guide words in the header name the first and last turn in view; each tool result is a bordered colour plate beside a black-text answer column.
options.case: Reviewers recognise the reference-book reading; engineers lose density and the dashboard's charts become islands.
options.risk: Reads bookish and slow on a working dashboard.

options.label: Terminal yellow wayfinding
options.thesis: One saturated yellow reserved for wayfinding: where you are, what is next, which run is followed.
options.viewport: A yellow band carries the agent and the next decision; tool calls arrive as black inset pictogram squares with their status.
options.case: Strongest product clarity of the hand; neither engineers nor policy reviewers see themselves in it.
options.risk: Yellow at full saturation tires the eye over a long review session.

options.label: Labanotation score
options.thesis: Time runs upward; block length is exact duration.
options.viewport: A centre staff with tool calls as shaded blocks.
options.case: Fuses poorly: neither reader identifies with dance notation and upward time fights chat order.

options.label: Jet-age ticket wallet
options.thesis: Each run a coupon; states stamp themselves on.
options.case: Fuses as costume: travel ephemera says nothing about agents or evidence.

options.label: Character goods catalog
options.viewport: A pastel roster of test cases.
options.case: Loses both axes: playful register undermines evidence.

options.label: Datamatics field
options.thesis: Pure black and white data at full density.
options.case: Loses both axes: art installation, hostile to reviewers.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A neutral developer-tool chat and dashboard, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Sidebar, chat column and tool cards the way most AI products ship them.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other agent UI by design.
